For our Aerospace Business Unit in Graz, Austria, we are seeking an experienced Space Systems Expert / Senior Systems Engineer with a strong systems engineering background and proven experience in spacecraft development. Experience in satellite or launcher propulsion systems and/or space mechanisms is highly desirable. This position combines technical leadership, customer interaction, and multidisciplinary system development activities.

º Define and maintain system architecture, technical baselines, requirements, and requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle
º Lead system trade studies, technical decision-making processes, and system performance assessments
º Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams across mechanical, electrical, software, manufacturing, and related disciplines
º Develop verification, validation, qualification, acceptance, and flight-readiness strategies, including participation in system-level testing campaigns
º Prepare compliance documentation and ensure alignment with customer and program requirements
º Serve as the primary technical interface to customers, suppliers, and partners, including supplier coordination
º Identify technical risks, define mitigation plans, and lead technical reviews and status meetings (SRR, PDR, CDR, QR, FAR)

º Successfully completed Master's degree or equivalent, preferably in the fields of Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Physics or a related field
º Minimum 5 years of professional experience in the aerospace or space industry
º Strong knowledge of systems engineering processes and lifecycle management
º Experience with: requirements engineering, system architecture development, verification & validation, risk management, technical reviews
º Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
º Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken
º Experience with spacecraft, launcher, payload, or propulsion system development
º Knowledge of ECSS standards
º Experience with MBSE (Model-Based Systems Engineering)
º Familiarity with tools such as DOORS, Enterprise Architect, STK; experience working with ESA, Airbus, OHB, ArianeGroup, Avio, or New Space organizations
º Your preferred qualifications
º Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
º Ability to work in multidisciplinary and international environments
º High level of technical curiosity combined with practical aerospace expertise
 
What the Cosumer Offer:
º Participation in exciting European and international space programs
º Opportunity to influence future propulsion and space technologies
º International project environment with leading aerospace partners
º Flexible working arrangements
º Professional development and training opportunities
º Competitive compensation package
º Modern engineering facilities and laboratories
º Collaborative and innovative company culture inspired by Magna's entrepreneurial spirit

Benefits:
